about_the_game:
🔹 About This Game

Star Loot is an online co-op sci-fi looting game filled with chaos, animal pirates, limited oxygen, and unpredictable dangers. You and up to three friends will dive into derelict space wrecks, grab everything that isn't nailed down, and try to make it back in one piece—ideally, with all of your limbs still attached.

🧑‍🚀 WHO YOU ARE

You’re a contract looter for a shady space pirate syndicate.
Alongside your questionable animal crewmates, your mission is simple: raid abandoned space wrecks, snatch as much loot as you can carry, and make it back before your oxygen or time runs out.

🚀 WHAT YOU DO

Suit up, pick a wreck, and dive in.
Each location offers procedurally generated layouts, creepy ambient threats, and an ever-ticking timer. Oxygen tanks deplete. Traps wait around every corner. The deeper the station, the better the loot—and the worse the odds.

🎤 HOW YOU SURVIVE

Communication and chaos go hand in hand.
Use proximity voice chat to coordinate—or sabotage—your crew. Carry oversized loot as a team, revive fallen pirates with rare tools, and avoid getting vaporized by a teammate’s accidental laser trap trigger. This isn’t a solo job... unless you want to die alone.

💰 WHY YOU KEEP GOING

Profit buys power—and pointless junk.
Sell what you recover to upgrade your ship’s core systems, unlock stronger gear, and access more dangerous missions. Or blow it all on useless (but hilarious) space junk, like a glowing llama or a toilet that sings sea shanties.

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 @ 3,3 GHz (4 CPUs)
